scope: Proposition 3.3 of the manuscript “An asymptotic formula for the number of totients” (preprints/An-asymptotic-formula-for-the-number-of-totients-September-25-2026/An-asymptotic-formula-for-the-number-of-totients-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 024 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5dda4f860a38357f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a set Ex ⊆ V ∩ [1, x] with |Ex| ≤ {εH + ox;H(1)}V (x) such that every preimage of every v ∈ (V ∩ [1, x]) \ Ex is p0 · · · pLa for a basic witness. One may take εH ≪ e−cP + KH exp{− exp(cPρ−P )}. For every basic witness, putting w = pR+1 · · · pLa, we have p1 · · · pLa ≤ exp((log x)0.8 ), log w ≤ H exp(0.62bR) + exp(2e bL), w < pR. (3.11) In particular w is bounded in terms of H alone, uniformly in the phase.
